findings.claim: The developer's parent, The Berkeley Group Holdings PLC, is Companies House number 05172586, status Active, incorporated 7 July 2004.
Registered office: Berkeley House, 19 Portsmouth Road, Cobham, Surrey, KT11 1JG.
Sutton Garden Square is a 5.6-acre regeneration project delivering over 1,000 homes.
One-bedroom apartments in the first phase, The Kensington, start from £375,000.
Construction of The Kensington collection began in 2026, with first homes completing from 2028.
Berkeley's own site describes The Pavilion amenities: co-working spaces, a gym, concierge, games room, pet spa and children's playroom.
In the year to April 2026, Berkeley completed 4,076 new homes across London and the South East, up from 4,047 the year before.
Berkeley reported net cash of £363 million after share buy-backs, and refinanced its bank facilities to total liquidity of £1.8 billion.
Pre-tax profit fell 14.7% to £451.4 million, in line with the company’s own guidance.
Berkeley says it has an industry-leading Net Promoter Score of +77.9 and ranks first for customer care and build quality on HomeViews. These figures come from Berkeley itself.

reading.observation: Two Companies House entities share very similar names: 'The Berkeley Group Holdings PLC' (05172586, the actual listed parent) and 'Berkeley Group PLC(The)' (01454064, an older, separately-numbered entity). A careless match could confirm the wrong one.
